title: Germany: who was left out?
hook: Did unification include the other major German power?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: Unification did not simply gather every German-speaking territory.

claims.text: 1864: Denmark. Prussia wins a war against Denmark.
claims.source: https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/reaktionszeit — Unification wars 1864, 1866, 1870/71; Reichsgründung 1871 on Austria exclusion; https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/kaiserreich/reich/reichsgruendung — Austria and unification after 1866

claims.text: 1866: Austria. War excludes Austria from Prussia’s unification path.
claims.source: https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/reaktionszeit — Unification wars 1864, 1866, 1870/71; Reichsgründung 1871 on Austria exclusion; https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/kaiserreich/reich/reichsgruendung — Austria and unification after 1866

claims.text: 1870–71: France. War against France precedes the empire.
claims.source: https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/reaktionszeit — Unification wars 1864, 1866, 1870/71; Reichsgründung 1871 on Austria exclusion; https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/kaiserreich/reich/reichsgruendung — Austria and unification after 1866

claims.text: 1871: Empire. A German Empire forms without Austria.
claims.source: https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/reaktionszeit — Unification wars 1864, 1866, 1870/71; Reichsgründung 1871 on Austria exclusion; https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/kaiserreich/reich/reichsgruendung — Austria and unification after 1866

claims.text: Unification did not simply gather every German-speaking territory. Prussia’s victory over Austria in 1866 made Austrian participation increasingly remote, and the empire formed after war against France. The outcome reflected conflicts between states as well as a national movement.
claims.source: https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/reaktionszeit — Unification wars 1864, 1866, 1870/71; Reichsgründung 1871 on Austria exclusion; https://www.dhm.de/lemo/kapitel/kaiserreich/reich/reichsgruendung — Austria and unification after 1866

recall.question: Was Austria included in the 1871 German Empire?
recall.why: Unification did not simply gather every German-speaking territory. Prussia’s victory over Austria in 1866 made Austrian participation increasingly remote, and the empire formed after war against France. The outcome reflected conflicts between states as well as a national movement.
